rule.description: 上游兼容性测试工作流不应在每次 PR 提交时触发，应仅通过定时任务（schedule）触发，避免不必要的 CI 资源消耗。工作流文件命名应清晰反映其用途。

antipattern.code:
# 上游兼容性测试不应在每次 PR 提交时触发

name: PR Test Upstream

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test-upstream:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run upstream tests
        run: |
          pip install git+https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git@main
          pytest tests/
